The Hanno Festival is scheduled for November 7–8, 2026 (Reiwa 8). We are now accepting sponsorship donations. New sponsorship amounts have been set to welcome contributions from individuals as well as businesses. You can sponsor the festival by bank transfer (details in the sponsorship guide) or by submitting an application form (available as PDF or via Google Form). See the sponsorship guide for full details.

More information: Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e4%bb%a4%e5%92%8c8%e5%b9%b4%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%81%be%e3%81%a4%e3%82%8a%e3%80%80%e5%8d%94%e8%b3%9b%e3%81%ae%e3%81%8a%e9%a1%98%e3%81%84)
